outcome: Complications (emergency hysterectomy, perforation of the uterine cavity, severe hemorrhage, endometritis)
cohort: Seven patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at early gestational age (<= 9 weeks).
finding: Associating systemic methotrexate and uterine artery embolization provides efficient and low-risk management for both types of Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP).
